name: Haven inference demo
description: Opper inference paid per call on Base Sepolia.

replay.statement: The same payment header does not buy a second call: once the call is delivered, presenting it again answers payment_already_delivered.

payment_response.statement: Every answer after settlement carries a PAYMENT-RESPONSE header with the settlement transaction hash.

upstream_answered.statement: A 3xx or 4xx from the upstream is wrapped into a 200 upstream_answered and the payment is used for that call; 401, 402, 403 and 407 are upstream_auth_refused, and 408, 429 and 5xx are failures.

on_failure_after_settlement.statement: The payment settled and the call failed: the answer is a 200 upstream_failed_after_settlement with the transaction hash, and the merchant's contact for what happens next is https://haven.example/merchant-kit.

products.description: Internal technical demo run by Haven on Base Sepolia: one chat completion on azure/gpt-5-mini through Opper, up to 1,000 output tokens. Test money only.
